title: module-reuse structure as a task coordinate
hypothesis: When tasks are generated by low-dimensional recombination of a fixed bank of reusable modules, a learned two-scalar Mirror task coordinate can preserve heldout task quality from fewer support examples and with fewer actual serialized bytes than storing independent module coefficients.
physical_object: Eight fixed shared scalar module functions with a learned low-dimensional recombination structure
mirror_coordinate: Two float32 coefficients at the module-output recombination interface
logical_multiplicity: Heldout task functions generated from a shared rank-2 recombination structure over eight fixed modules
controls: independent full module coefficient vector fitted on support
native PCA rank-2 basis with task coordinates

development.selection_metric: No hyperparameter tuning; confirm frozen implementation and quality/byte calculations only.

world.modules: Eight fixed nonlinear scalar functions phi_j(x)=tanh(w_j dot x + b_j), W and b drawn from the world seed and shared across all tasks in that world
world.task_generation: Teacher module coefficients a_t=z_t B, with z_t~N(0,I_2), B in R^(2x8) drawn once per world and normalized row-wise; train and heldout task z values are independent
world.observations: y=sum_j a_tj phi_j(x)+epsilon, epsilon~N(0,0.03^2); each task gets an independently seeded support/test sample
world.training: Estimate train-task module coefficient vectors by least squares using 128 train examples per task; estimate rank-2 structure only from those train tasks.

policy.mirror: Project support-fit coefficient estimates onto rank-2 basis learned from training tasks and infer two task coordinates from support examples
policy.native_pca: Use identical centered rank-2 PCA/bilinear decoder and support inference; expected exact functional alias
policy.independent: Fit eight module coefficients directly from new-task support
policy.codebook: Choose nearest of 12 training-task coefficient vectors by support prediction loss; codebook is fully serialized
policy.random_basis: Use a seeded random orthonormal rank-2 basis, then infer two coordinates
policy.quality: Heldout mean squared function error (MSE) and relative excess over teacher irreducible noise
policy.support_efficiency: Minimum frozen support size meeting the quality gate; report all sizes regardless

storage.authority: Exact serialized inference payload bytes from custom deterministic little-endian float32/int32 payloads
paid_objects: eight module weight vectors and biases
per-target rank-2 coordinate or independent coefficient vector
full codebook entries and codebook header
storage.amortization: For six heldout tasks, charge shared module bank, learned basis or codebook once and every task's private coordinate/coefficient; report total and per-task amortized bytes
storage.excluded: Training examples are not inference state; no other reconstruction state is free.

report: training coefficient-fit and basis-fit wall time
inference wall time on the same host

success_gate: At a support size no greater than 8, learned structural coordinate achieves heldout MSE <= 0.0025 in every fresh world and total six-task payload is at least 10% smaller than independent coefficients; Mirror-specific value additionally requires beating native PCA at comparable bytes/compute.
failure_gate: Any quality or byte gate miss, codebook/native control match, or exact native PCA alias fails Mirror-specific attribution. Negative results remain registered.
boundaries: Synthetic nonlinear module bank only; not a trained neural network or RL result.
The task family is deliberately generated from a rank-2 teacher; no arbitrary-task capacity claim.
Only one fixed module bank and six heldout tasks per world are tested.
No claim about sample efficiency beyond this support-size sweep or general PA234 reproduction.

protocol_amendments.timing: before implementation and before fresh seeds were accessed
protocol_amendments.change: Byte arithmetic for six heldout task views implies 408 B rank-2 shared payload versus 488 B independent; byte gate set at 10% rather than 20%, retaining a margin below the computed 16.4% saving.
